title: Photoresistor Voltage Divider Explorer
description: Light level in, resistance and divider voltage out -- with a curve showing why the fixed resistor choice matters.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

educational.audience: Students wiring their first analog sensor

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a simulated light level, the learner calculates the resulting LDR resistance and voltage-divider output.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Drag the light level and swap the fixed resistor between 1k, 10k, and 100k
pedagogical.assessment: Set a light level and ask for the output voltage before reading it off.
